hints.title: Constant-Time Member Lookups
hints.text: Repeated linear searches across nums would turn traversal quadratic. Converting elements into an efficient lookup structure allows instant filtering.

hints.title: Sentinel Dummy Head
hints.text: Using a sentinel node pointing to the original head eliminates edge cases where the head itself must be removed.

hints.title: Pointer Re-linking
hints.text: Traverse the sequence. If the successor node's value is marked for deletion, splice it out by rewiring current.next to current.next.next without advancing current.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def modifiedList(self, nums: list[int], head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        remove_set = set(nums)
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        curr = dummy
        while curr.next:
            if curr.next.val in remove_set:
                curr.next = curr.next.next
            else:
                curr = curr.next
        return dummy.next
```

complexity.notes: Building the lookup set takes O(m) time and linear traversal takes O(n) steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching an unsorted array for every list node takes O(m * n) time which exceeds execution limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Using O(m) auxiliary memory achieves optimal linear runtime.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies dummy node pattern and set membership for O(1) removals.
